fr-bourbon.title: Flag of Bourbon France

colors.note: The royal colour of the Bourbon monarchy.

desc: - The Bourbon Restoration (1815–1830) returned to the plain white flag of the Ancien Régime, abandoning the revolutionary tricolour
trivia:
- The Bourbon dynasty ruled France from 1589 to 1848 (with interruptions)
- The fleur-de-lis represented royal authority and French monarchy
- One of Europe's longest-ruling dynasties

fr-free-france.title: Flag of Free France

colors.note: Fraternity. The Cross of Lorraine was added by de Gaulle.

desc: - Free France (1940–1944) used the French tricolour with the red Cross of Lorraine superimposed, the emblem chosen by Charles de Gaulle to resist Nazi occupation
- **Construction:** the French Tricolore defaced with a red Cross of Lorraine. The cross is centred or placed in the canton
trivia:
- Free France (1940–1944) represented the French Resistance during WWII
- Charles de Gaulle led the fight against Nazi occupation
- The Cross of Lorraine became the symbol of Free France
